_doc: Every tunable number of the energy system and the Pokemon-vs-Pokemon battle, in one place (read through battle/battle_config.gd; design/energy_system.md explains each). Change numbers here, not in code. Species overrides under focus.species.<id> win over the defaults.

focus._doc: Focus is a 0-100 meter per Pokemon. chips = min(floor(focus / step), chip_cap): the bar and the chip count always agree. gain: points per undisturbed turn. start: focus at the first battle of a fresh Pokemon. wild_start: a wild one's focus by its state when the battle starts. typed_pool_cap: chips a typed pool holds (Colorless holds the rest). auto_fill_single_type: a Pokemon with one typed pool sends new chips there until it is full (zero taps); otherwise new chips go to the default pool unless the player picks.

disruption._doc: Disruption lowers focus by a fixed step, never a full reset. step: the default. moves: per-move steps (overrides). flinch / confusion: the step when that status lands. sleep_blocks_gain: no focus gain while asleep.

locked_in._doc: At max focus the Pokemon is Locked In. mode: acc_crit (acc_bonus to accuracy, crit_stages more crit), wild_chip (one extra chip that counts as any type), or both. Any disrupting hit removes it.

locks._doc: Reaction chips. expiry_turns: a lock not triggered releases at the end of the turn after the one it was set in (1). Released chips go back to the pool.

slots._doc: Energy slots: how many moves a Pokemon can have equipped (usable). gain_per_slot: focus a turn for each equipped move past gain_from (more slots, a faster build). level -> slots; the highest key at or below its level wins. Moves are never forgotten: known moves beyond the slots show locked in the move list. wild_equip: latest (a wild or fresh Pokemon equips its newest moves, as in the games) | balanced (an opener, a mid and a finisher it can pay, a reaction, a disruption and a support move, then the strongest).

finisher._doc: Finisher moves cost every unlocked chip ({all, min, type} in moves.json). power = the move's power (its base) + power_per_chip (the move's own, else power_per_chip_default) per chip spent. max_chips caps the chips that count (0 = no cap). min_default: the minimum when a move leaves it out.

matchups._doc: Type matchups, TCG style, for species whose data names a weakness and a resistance (energy kinds; the Kanto 151 dataset): weakness_mult (the card game's x2), resistance_mult (a reduction, multiplied) and resistance_sub (subtracted after the damage, the card game's -20 / -30; 0 = off). In TCG mode the chart's immunities become tcg_immunity_mult (the card game has no immunities; 0 keeps them). mode: auto (TCG for species with the data, the chart otherwise) | chart | tcg. tcg_chart_resist_mult: in TCG mode, a move the chart calls not very effective is also multiplied by this (1 = off).

costs._doc: Move cost overrides (move id -> list of energy kinds); empty means the cost in moves.json. Two-phase moves are paid on the commit turn only. off_pool: a typed chip of a kind the Pokemon has no pool for is paid in Colorless, plus extra Colorless chips (the v1 rule: off-type costs Colorless, one chip more); a finisher of a kind it lacks takes any chips, at least finisher_extra more.

rarity._doc: Species efficiency by rarity (the Kanto 151 rarity field): a shared (non-signature) move's power x shared_power_mult[rarity]. Signature moves already carry their rarity in their numbers (kanto151_balance.json). level_stat {levels, bonus, min, max}: battle stats x (1 + the rarity's bonus at the level), bonus[rarity] a list of points at levels (straight lines between, flat past the ends), clamped to min..max; empty = 1.

stats._doc: Battle stats from base stats: stat = 2 x base x (level + level_offset) / 100 + 5 (HP: + level + 10), and the damage formula's level term uses level + level_offset too. level_offset flattens the level curve so a few levels are a clear step up, not a wall (0 = the games' formula).

damage._doc: damage = ((2L/5 + 2) * power * A/D / 50 + 2) * stab * type * crit * random * scale. scale keeps several moves a turn from ending fights too fast. para_scope: turn (one roll a turn decides every action of a paralysed Pokemon) | action (a roll for each).

effects._doc: Numbers for the wider effect vocabulary (the Kanto 151 tags, kanto151_balance.json effects): heal (share of max HP), barrier_turns (Reflect, Light Screen), focus_up / focus_drain / focus_down_self (focus points), all_up_chance (Ancient Power's chance to raise every stat).

counters._doc: The interaction table. vs: the target's state (underground, airborne, underwater, charging, dodge, protect, ghost, evasion). hits: true lets the move through that state. mult: damage multiplier. pull_out: chance to end the target's two-phase move. breaks: removes that state. force_out: ends the target's two-phase move. disrupt: extra focus loss. ignores: the states this move ignores (Swift).

decay._doc: Focus between battles, by game time (GameClock minutes), never real time. An alert Pokemon keeps its focus for grace_minutes, then loses per_hour; a relaxed one loses relaxed_per_hour and never keeps more than relaxed_floor_cap after a rest. locked_in_grace_minutes: the Locked In buff fades much sooner. rests: focus multipliers for story rests. center_keep: a Pokemon Center keeps this fraction (a partial relax). in_gym_per_hour: decay inside a gym (warm-up keeps).

gym_warmup._doc: Gym trainers before the leader warm a Pokemon up: after each won gym-trainer battle it keeps its end focus (keep) plus bonus, up to max_carry. The leader's Pokemon start at leader_start. Tuned so two or three trainers (which cost HP and items) give about 2 extra chips on the leader's turn 1.

perks._doc: Items, abilities and trainer bonuses that shape focus: start (added to the starting focus), gain (added per turn), chip_cap (more chips), disrupt_resist (0-1 of each disruption ignored).

items._doc: The energy restore category: rare and expensive. chips: chips added now (focus rises to match, so the bar and the count agree), pool: where they go (colorless, own = the Pokemon's first type, or a kind), focus: a burst of focus points, focus_to: focus set to at least this. price in Pokedollars, rarity: shop | rare | unique. All placeholders.

energy_shard.name: Energy Shard
energy_shard.desc: A sliver of crystal that hums. One Colorless chip, now.

focus_crystal.name: Focus Crystal
focus_crystal.desc: A rare crystal from Mt. Moon. Two chips of the Pokemon's own type.

focus_tonic.name: Focus Tonic
focus_tonic.desc: A bitter drink. A burst of focus.

full_charge.name: Full Charge
full_charge.desc: Extremely rare. Straight to max focus.

ai._doc: Planner weights. wild_styles: the wild planner (damage, status, per_action, big, force_out, repeat). personalities: trainer AI multipliers on each role's value and how often it sets a reaction when it can (reaction_rate), answers a two-phase foe with a counter (counter_rate), commits to its own two-phase moves (two_phase_rate). waste: the cost of an unspent chip. status_value: what an effect is worth. status_repeat_turn: a status move's value for each time it is already in this turn's plan. min_action_value: below it an action is worth no more than unspent chips. self_faint_hp: Self-Destruct and the like only at or below this HP share. two_phase_value, finisher_value: how the planner rates a two-phase move's and a finisher's power. status_scale: all effect values. reaction_rate_scale: every personality's reaction_rate.
